title: Prefix Tag
description: Fully configurable mod that adds a prefix for your server for roleplay and pvp tier
body:
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1486306690390560798?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&label=Discord&labelColor=FFFFFF&color=5865F2)](https://discord.gg/https://discord.gg/zN84wm2Avh)
![Modrinth Version](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/v/alIqocl4?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&labelColor=FFFFFF&color=%2327A157)
![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-active-20B2AA?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=FFFFFF)
[![Ko-fi](https://img.shields.io/badge/Ko--fi-support%20me-FF5E5B?style=for-the-badge&logo=kofi&labelColor=FFFFFF)](https://ko-fi.com/cursedbee21)

**PrefixTag** adds a dual tier system to your Minecraft server. Every player carries two independent ranks - one for Roleplay (R1–R5) and one for PvP (P1–P5) (or whatever u want xd) - always displayed as a combined prefix next to their name in chat and above their head in the world.

---

## ✦ How it works

When a player joins the server for the **first time**, a selection screen appears. They choose their **Rol tier** and then their **PvP tier**. From that moment on, their prefix - for example `[R2|P3]` - is permanently visible in chat and above their head, with colors that reflect their tier level.

Admins can reassign, reset, recolor or clear the custom name of any player at any time using simple commands.

---

## ✦ Features

- **Rol tiers** — chosen by the player on first join
- **PvP tiers** — chosen by the player on first join
- **Configurable tier count** — set between 2 and 10 tiers independently for Rol and PvP
- **Tier colors** — each tier has its own configurable color
- **Name color** — admins can set a custom color for each player's name
- **Custom display name** — players can replace their username with a custom name
- **Prefix in chat and nametag** — always visible, always up to date
- **First-join GUI** — clean two-step selection screen, can't be skipped
- **Admin commands** — override, reset, recolor or clear any player's data at any time
- **Config file** — customize tier count, labels, GUI texts and colors via `prefixtag-server.toml`
- **NBT persistence** — all data survives restarts and reconnections

---

## ✦ Commands


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

### Admin — requires op level 2

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/tier setrol <player> <1-10>` | Set a player's Rol tier |
| `/tier setpvp <player> <1-10>` | Set a player's PvP tier |
| `/tier setcolor <player> <color>` | Set the color of a player's name |
| `/tier clearname <player>` | Remove a player's custom display name |
| `/tier online <player> <true\|false>` | Toggle the online indicator (●) on a player's prefix |
| `/tier check <player>` | View a player's current prefix and display name |
| `/tier reset <player>` | Reset a player's tiers — they'll see the GUI on next login |

### Player — no permissions required

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/tierself setname <name>` | Set a custom display name (no color codes allowed) |
| `/tierself clearname` | Remove your custom display name |

</details>



**Available colors:** `black`, `dark_blue`, `dark_green`, `dark_aqua`, `dark_red`, `dark_purple`, `gold`, `gray`, `dark_gray`, `blue`, `green`, `aqua`, `red`, `light_purple`, `yellow`, `white`

---

## ✦ Configuration

On first launch, PrefixTag generates a `prefixtag-server.toml` file in the `world/serverconfig` folder where you can customize:

- Number of active tiers for Rol and PvP independently (2–10)
- Tier labels (e.g. change `R1` to `Novice`)
- GUI titles and descriptions
- Tier colors for each level
- Tier tooltips shown when hovering over each tier button

---

**You are free to include this mod in any modpack**
